C1599.title: Ministry of Public Security Publishes Typical Cases on Combating Hacker Crime
C1599.summary: China's Ministry of Public Security published eight typical cases on combating hacker crime, covering illegal intrusion, control of computer information systems, data theft, provision of hacking tools, and network attacks. The cases illustrate law-enforcement action against hacker-crime supply chains.

references.title: Public security authorities make significant progress in cracking down on hacker crime; Ministry of Public Security publishes eight typical cases
